audit.rule: Connected components of raw/standardized exact pixel equality or 8x8 mean hash Hamming distance <=2; one representative, priority train then validation then test then lexical source_id. All original splits retained; no score-dependent filtering.
audit.caution: Average hash similarity is conservative screening; it can cluster distinct photographs with similar layouts. This audit does not establish that every candidate was a semantic duplicate.

ranking_scores: Float64 linear decision scores for every logistic model; raw payload agreement for active. Probabilities, fits, fusion inputs and validation thresholds unchanged.
